families.transition: active_attempt -> terminal_attempt; terminal outcome must have success=true or failure_class, never both; retry/backoff evidence is not a second dispatch.
families.source_predicate_contract: Before completion the exact original attempt is active and in-flight work is reconciled. Terminal success is done; terminal failure has its canonical classified failure.

families.transition: admitted candidate -> started attempt; frozen permission/model/runtime snapshots and exact worktree baseline are durable before the barrier; increment policy counters once before worker spawn.
families.source_predicate_contract: The exact new attempt is admitted, immutable requested/effective snapshots are durable, and the owner worktree baseline is valid. Append before worker spawn.

families.transition: eligible node -> blocked episode; mint blocked_sequence once per actual episode under node CAS. Before an attempt exists omit attempt_id. Required restore anchors and snapshot refs publish atomically with the block, never fabricate a prior attempt.
families.source_predicate_contract: The same node has a newly accepted block cause and a reserved new blocked_sequence. Retry resolves that original episode rather than minting another sequence.

families.transition: verified -> done or verify_pending -> failed; preserve verifier and packaging evidence. Removing a node from the ready set cannot complete it.
families.source_predicate_contract: For result_outcome=done the original node is verified; for failed it is verify_pending. Actual verifier evidence must resolve and match the attempt.

families.transition: queued -> in_progress after admitted readiness and frozen actual attempt; a ready event alone cannot start a node.
families.source_predicate_contract: The node is queued, actual dependencies satisfy readiness, and the exact attempt is admitted; transition only then to in_progress.

families.transition: matching unresolved blocked episode -> resolved; require the exact ordered action/current prerequisite and durable recovery result. No stale approval and no safe-point anchor release before its owner terminal result.
families.source_predicate_contract: The exact original blocked_sequence is unresolved; its resolution evidence is durable and any required recovery-anchor release is permitted by the existing owner. Unblocking itself grants no restore success.

families.transition: pre-lock decomposition -> degraded pre-lock shape; graph_locked=true rejects. Shapes are redacted bounded shape descriptors, not plan bodies; evidence_ref resolves the original evidence.
families.source_predicate_contract: Decomposition input is pre_lock and actual shape/evidence match the original analysis. Locked graph failure is refused as degradation.

families.transition: active remediation child -> fixed, superseded, abandoned or replan_required with exact original parent/root/child joins; ceiling_exceeded is blocked-state evidence, not a current resolution.
families.source_predicate_contract: The exact root/child is active, the referenced child is terminal and resolution evidence is durable; fixed additionally requires child success. Other current resolutions keep their existing owner meaning.

families.transition: classified failed parent -> admitted remediation child, within existing generation/ceiling policy; append lineage before child dispatch; child_attempt_id is the child attempt identity, never the parent.
families.source_predicate_contract: The actual parent has a classified failure, existing remediation ceilings permit this generation, and the exact distinct child is admitted; append before child dispatch.

families.transition: active run -> owner-declared terminal result only after all required Document Set packaging audits pass and in-flight work is reconciled. Canonical usage remains usage.event; optional usage_ref resolves the UF-085 snapshot; no legacy inline token tuple.
families.source_predicate_contract: The run is active, in-flight work is reconciled and owner terminal evidence is valid, in addition to mandatory Document Set packaging checks.

families.transition: active graph validation -> integrity failure and replan path; never convert locked graph corruption into pre-lock decomposition degradation or blind retry.
families.source_predicate_contract: The actual active run graph has failed validation; this is evidence of graph integrity failure and only the owner replan path may repair it.

families.transition: matching active backoff -> elapsed wake only at or after durable backoff_until_utc; no attempt dispatch or success inferred from timer expiry.
families.source_predicate_contract: The exact prior attempt has an active backoff and its timer matches the original backoff record; now must be at or beyond backoff_until_utc. Expiry is only a wake.

retry_policy.counter_scope: original classified error_id within its actual attempt

families.transition: classified retryable failure -> scheduled backoff with existing per-error budgets; no retry of graph_integrity, verification_failed or reviewer_findings; timer never converts to terminal success.
families.source_predicate_contract: The prior attempt has a classified retryable failure and its actual per-error retry budget remains. backoff_until_utc cannot precede the first recorded observation.

retry_policy.counter_scope: original classified error_id within its actual attempt

families.transition: not ready -> dependency-satisfying ready; all blockers resolve and current graph/Spec Lock/capacity requirements pass. Preserve ready_since_utc while continuously ready, do not dispatch from this event.
families.source_predicate_contract: The node was not ready; its actual dependencies and graph/Spec Lock now satisfy readiness. Continuing readiness preserves the original timestamp rather than another entry event.

families.transition: classified prior attempt -> scheduled successor admission under the existing retry budget; preserve prior identity, verify safe-point/worktree and refresh permission before any distinct successor attempt.
families.source_predicate_contract: The exact prior attempt is classified, actual retry budget remains and baseline is valid; no new attempt may dispatch without fresh permission and safe-point owner checks.

retry_policy.counter_scope: original classified error_id within its actual attempt

families.transition: one pending wake set -> one scored pass, before dispatch; first recovery wake is startup_recovered. Select at most available_slots using the canonical score order, retain every nonselected ready node and its exclusion reason. Legacy non_selected is import-only.
families.source_predicate_contract: The exact wake set is pending with no previously committed pass. Original pass identity, ready/selected/nonselected partition, scores, capacity and first recovery wake are preserved.
